section: Louisiana property tax: state rules: figures under review
label: Homestead exemption
value: First $7,500 of assessed value (about $75,000 of market value) of an owner-occupied home
note: Louisiana Constitution Art. VII, Sec. 20. A 2025 amendment (to $12,500 assessed from 2027) went to voters on Nov 3, 2026; result not verified. Snippet only.
source_title: Louisiana Legislature: bill digest on the homestead exemption (legis.la.gov document)

section: Louisiana real estate transfer tax: figures under review
label: State real estate transfer tax
value: None: the state levies no transfer tax, and the constitution bars any new transfer tax (state or local) since November 30, 2011
note: Art. VII, Sec. 2.3. The ban covers new taxes only; recordation fees and ad valorem taxes are excluded. Snippet only.
source_title: Louisiana Legislature: Constitution Art. VII, Sec. 2.3 (Power to tax; limitation; sale or transfer of immovable property)
